2 Separate MySQL replica DATA EQUIVALENCE gate from FRESHNESS gate and resource gate. Require owner record of source/channel->schema/table/generation mapping incl name rewrites/multi-source if applicable, current AND historical source/binlog and channel/global replication filters, complete initial copy provenance and all subsequent re-seeding/rebuilds/DDL, skip/emptyGTID/manualrepair/localwrite histories using existing approved consistency audit/change records. No automatic prod COUNT/checksum/ANALYZE/repair/filter changes to prove integrity. If equivalence unknown, result is precisely count of THIS COPY only; original service table exact request UNKNOWN/HOLD, even if lag0/freshness good. If equivalence qualified, still record allowed snapshotpoint/freshness separately, never claim original primarycurrent exact just from GTID. Add fillable lineage audit fields + update filled examples to explicitly fictional lineage qualification for independentrestore vs hold/unknown replica. Do not fabricate labfilter/drift test. Existing lab replicates t_repl only so cannot use its goodlag to prove other tables covered.
3 Both products require HAowner authoritative role/topology/routing epoch/collection age/event source and applicable approval. Include concrete read-only MySQL observation path e.g existing HA topologyexport and server UUID/read_only/super_read_only + SHOW REPLICA STATUS channel/source UUID, GR member role/state only for actual GR; neither readonly flag nor channel existence alone authoritative role. No auto grants/globalinstrument/config changes. SQL existing AG local role/is_primary_replica via existing DMVs/HAcollector, intendedlistener/actualserver/DB routing checks. No bare ApplicationIntent=ReadOnly guarantee. On promotion/role/routing/epoch change or stale/unavailable/unknown role, qualification EXPIRES: stop new work, cancel currently owned query through existing verified identity/finally/rollback/release/recovery path, results HOLD pending approval, requalify identity+role+dataequivalence+resources+freshness before resume. Never blind reconnect/retry; new physical session after driver/proxy retries requires freshgate. Pin actualbackend/lease or HOLD if cannot observe. Promotion candidate must integrate HAowner procedure/events with stop gate and cancellation/release acknowledgment BEFORE promotion accepts service workload where required; no synchronization possible => use independent restored copy. Polling only narrows detection delay; not race-free prevention. Don't require COUNT to prevent essential failover: HApriority, unknown termination=>incident escalation/no newCOUNT, no safe-primary guarantee. No automatic failover experiment necessary; unverified integration => HOLD. All newsemantics must cite primary officialdocs, do not copy long quotes. Current receipt may be absent until owner and two Sol reviewers complete, allowed pending link. Return JSON status,files,unresolvedIssues; no acceptance assertion.
